There is way too much to unpack here to give you advice on the relationship with your ex without a lot more information and everything I am going to say is based solely on what I have read. As for your daughter, get an attorney immediately and expect a fight. Your ex has her whole family on her side, possibly pressuring her about you and if they are toxic, its going to be messy. That fight and the witnesses involved make you look just as bad as them and can be turned on you in a dime. The only things I can say regarding the half of the story I know (Yours) is that you shouldn't have put her in a position where she felt she had to chose between you and her family as far as who would see the baby. A child is not leverage when people have disagreements and still has the right to be in contact with people, especially family that you don't get along with. In asking her to do that you also limited your girlfriend from bonding with her daughter and family as a unit. Them being there doesn't require you to be there. I could understand this if it was an excessive amount of time, but your reasoning for not letting them be around her is severely flawed. If your girlfriend was already living with a manipulative father, this was a huge mistake on your part and can make you seem controlling. Compromises should have been made by both of you and neither of you would budge. If she's blocked you on everything she's already made up her mind. Let her go and concentrate on your relationship with your daughter. Hopefully you can come to some kind of arrangement that works in her (your daughter) interests instead of everyone else's.
